basic_info.description: An Urban Retreat with Modern Elegance in a Prime Location. Nestled in the vibrant Yerba Buena District, this contemporary 1BR condominium offers a unique blend of modern design, luxurious features, and unparalleled convenience. Perfect for professionals, couples, or anyone seeking a stylish sanctuary in the heart of the city. Tall ceilings and walls of windows bathe the interiors with natural sunlight while offering serene views of the tropical lush courtyard. The interiors are enhanced by elegant white flooring complemented by rich dark wood cabinetry in the chef's kitchen. Generous closet space and in-unit W/D to ensure effortless living. The HOA features: On-site management, 24/7 lobby attendant, package management, Amazon room, and a landscaped courtyard. Steps away from the Yerba Buena Center, SF MOMA, Whole Foods, Trader Joes on 4th St, Oracle Park, worldclass dining, museums, shopping, entertainment, and the beautiful Embarcadero. Secure parking with interior access is available. Crunch Fitness with a heated lap pool is in the building (membership required). Easy access to 101/80 freeways, Muni Bus & T-Line, Caltrain & BART. Tech offices: Google, Meta, Salesforce, Amazon, and Microsoft.
